prompts.mood_pout: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent desktop-pet animation sprite sheet. Create a 1024x1024 PNG with EXACTLY FOUR FULL-BODY frames in a 2x2 grid of equal 512px square cells, reading top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Input image 1 is a reference ONLY: the exact shipped adult chibi dragon-woman character, costume, head diameter, head-to-body ratio, torso and leg lengths, drawing style and palette. It is a horizontal strip, not an output layout. Input image 2 is a reference ONLY for the same character's gentle unhappy body language and seated anatomy; do not copy its horizontal layout. Keep the SAME camera zoom and unchanged head size in all four cells. Silver-lilac short fluffy hair and ahoge, pearl lilac horns, pointed ears, lavender eyes, green hair clip and ivory flower, lavender scarf, sage cardigan with flower embroidery, cream dress, white socks, sneakers, TWO small lavender bat wings and ONE scaled lavender tail. Exactly two arms, two human hands, two legs. Each whole body including horns, fingers, wings, tail and shoes must fit inside its cell with generous transparent margin. Upright frames must keep the same planted shoe baseline and full-length torso as image 1. True alpha-zero transparent background; NO checkerboard drawn, floor, cast shadow, scenery, labels, text, symbols, watermarks, motion marks or props. Maintain the reference's delicate outlined painted anime style, not a new character or younger baby body. Cute displeasure, never violent rage or cheerful smile. Four consecutive key poses for a cute small angry reaction after being treated roughly. 1: stand with both feet planted, eyebrows draw inward, closed small mouth, hands tense just below chest, shoulders slightly raised. 2: gently fold both arms across her cardigan and purse her lips. 3: keep arms crossed, puff BOTH cheeks slightly, small sulky frown, wings fold closer, tail tip curls sideways. 4: same crossed-arm stance, chin lifted just a little, one small displeased sideways glance, still pouting. No foot stamping, shouting, pointing, turning her back, tears, or recovery to happiness. End still visibly mildly annoyed.
